disposition_reason: The original conference paper supplies ordered macro-F1 targets for nine distinct Bugeon label/exposure panels, and pinned author code defines their readout and split regimes. A complete original panel may support a predeclared, precisely scoped paper comparison. Exact paper-era artifact equivalence, native reference execution, meaningful-effect/uncertainty policy and concrete budgets remain unresolved, so this is a source-grounded design rather than an admitted task.

source_paper.title: Know Thyself by Knowing Others: Learning Neuron Identity from Population Context

evidence.supports: Nine Bugeon macro-F1 panel results averaged across five training seeds; Table 1 and Table 8 captions identify the accompanying bars as SD, while the paper checklist calls them SEM. Bar type and normalization therefore remain unresolved. The macro-F1 means and panel identities remain valid; EI inductive LOLCAT exceeds NuCLR.

evidence.locator: Appendix B.3 and D.4, pages 19 and 22
evidence.supports: Calcium population input and the three Bugeon exposure/split regimes; four development sessions excluded from final test.
Nine named split files and resampling readout route; downloadable split bytes are not immutable or verified here.

evidence.locator: balanced_resampling; logreg_scores; checkpoint selection and final prediction concatenation
evidence.supports: Train-only standardization, logistic regression, CV macro-F1 selection and pooled final macro-F1 aggregation.
Five SB028 sessions excluded from representation training; one is development-only.
Session-local neuron IDs, transcriptomic label derivation, fluorescence normalization, and omitted UniqueID ingestion.
Embedding float32 conversion, increasing-epoch ordering and matching neuron IDs across checkpoints.

target.description: Predict Bugeon neuron identity in one or more complete, predeclared original label/exposure panels: E/I, five-subclass or eleven-class labels crossed with transductive, transductive-zero-shot or inductive-zero-shot evaluation. Claim scope must name the selected original panel; unrelated panels are not universally required.

dataset.description: Bugeon transcriptomic calcium data, represented as bugeon_transcriptomic_2022 in the pinned preparation code; exact source archive, metadata and paper-era split byte identities still require acquisition validation.

cohort.description: Source data comprise seventeen sessions across four mice. For the selected original label level and exposure regime, preserve the complete source-eligible neuron population, stimulus subrecordings and training/test subject structure. Repeated-cell linkage and label-map joins remain execution holds.

split.description: Source protocols are neuron-wise transductive, four-subject leave-one-out transductive zero-shot, and SB028-held-out inductive zero-shot with three-subject CV. Preserve the exact released split for the selected panel, including development-session exclusions. Conference-equivalent split bytes are not verified; stochastic training reruns do not authorize regenerated or changed fixed splits.

inputs.description: Calcium population activity supplies representations; transcriptomic labels train the downstream readout only within source folds. Transductive representation training sees test-population activity; inductive representation training excludes all SB028 sessions.

preprocessing.description: Pinned preparation concatenates stimulus experiments with one-hour offsets, retains session-local neuron indices and forms fluorescence normalized by its flattened 99th percentile. Readout casts/standardizes embeddings using training data and uses author class resampling, without substituting class weighting.

metric.description: Macro F1: average of per-class 2TP/(2TP+FP+FN) for the author evaluator label set; source sklearn macro-F1 behavior must be retained. Accuracy and balanced accuracy are diagnostics, not interchangeable victory metrics.

aggregation.description: Within each panel, concatenate selected outer-test predictions before macro-F1; choose each checkpoint by pooled CV macro-F1. Conference scores then average five training seeds. Do not average subjects or all nine panels into an invented source score.

comparison.primary_metric: Macro-F1 for a complete predeclared original Bugeon label/exposure panel; the stored five-subclass inductive-zero-shot scalar is a provenance anchor applicable only to that panel

published_baseline.description: Anchor: NuCLR five-subclass inductive 0.3938 ± 0.0556. Remaining NuCLR means (transductive/transductive-zero-shot/inductive): EI 0.8110/0.6826/0.6738; five-subclass 0.6101/0.4014/0.3938; eleven-class 0.4056/0.2333/0.1990. For EI inductive, the paper also reports stronger LOLCAT 0.7463 ± 0.0095; beating 0.6738 alone does not surpass that source-paper result. The stored scalar applies only to the five-subclass inductive panel. Before admission, bind the matching table entry and source comparators for the selected original panel; this inventory does not select an easier panel after results.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: Pinned author preprocessing, training and readout provide a recovery route, but no authentic reference run on verified conference-equivalent splits has been established. Source-conformant stochastic training reruns may be used only with documented seed/protocol provenance, a predeclared calibration tolerance and paired author/candidate comparison; the selected panel’s fixed released splits must still be recovered.

minimum_effect.rationale: Predeclare panel-specific practically meaningful macro-F1 gains after validating source label prevalence and reference repeatability. Published seed standard deviations are not effect thresholds; no common made-up delta is admitted.

uncertainty.method: Predeclare paired method comparisons across source-conformant training seeds and the original subject structure for the selected panel. Address multiplicity only for the endpoint family actually selected; quantify conditional-on-cohort and population-generalization uncertainty separately.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Mouse for biological generalization; independently trained seed for optimization variability. Repeated neuron observations and CV folds are not independent mice.
uncertainty.rationale: If the inductive panel is selected, its one test mouse (SB028) cannot support a mouse-population confidence claim by treating neurons or seeds as independent animals. Repeated-cell identities require reconciliation; source-conformant stochastic replicates measure optimization variability without changing the fixed split.

paper_win_requires: Predeclare a complete endpoint/panel actually evaluated in the original paper before candidate development or result-based selection. Retain its original label level, exposure regime, complete eligible cohort, fixed split files, readout, metric and aggregation.

Surpass that panel’s matching published source result and calibrated author rerun by the predeclared meaningful amount under valid uncertainty, retaining required source controls and companion quality metrics. If EI inductive is selected, retain the stronger original LOLCAT0.7463 comparator; beating NuCLR0.6738 alone does not surpass that stronger source result. A weaker rerun cannot lower the published target.

Freeze the selected endpoint family, meaningful effects and uncertainty rule before candidate selection. Unrelated Bugeon panels need not all improve, but no favorable label level, easier exposure regime or neuron subset may be selected after results.

Report the complete selected panel, its required controls/companion metrics and the exact scoped claim. Do not describe a panel-specific result as improvement across all nine panels or the whole paper.

For stochastic steps actually present in the original protocol, permit a source-conformant rerun only with recorded seeds/provenance, predeclared calibration tolerance and paired author/candidate evaluation. This does not relax recovery of fixed released split artifacts.
Complete native reference qualification, final-evaluation protection and concrete common access/compute budgets before admitting an improvement episode.

current_sota.description: The paper tables establish source-era comparators only. No present-day SOTA survey or claim was performed.

episode.improvement_loop: After admission, iterate on representations using only the selected original panel’s source training/development information and author CV feedback, preserving its full cohort, label level and exposure regime. Hold source test labels owner-side and record all declared endpoint selection before candidate development.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze method/code, inputs, context policy, hyperparameters, source-conformant stochastic protocol, seeds/provenance, calibration tolerance, allowed checkpoint-selection rule, fixed split/label digests, selected endpoint and required companion success rules before final scoring.
episode.final_evaluation: Run the frozen candidate and qualified source comparators on the complete selected original panel with unchanged fixed splits. Publish the scoped endpoint result, required source controls/companion metrics and predeclared uncertainty. Source-conformant stochastic reruns preserve original task conditions; a new subject split is an extension.
episode.baseline_policy: Keep published table values, calibrated stochastic author reruns and current SOTA separate. Match the source baseline to the predeclared panel and disclose rerun provenance/tolerance. A supplied-embedding local readout or context-ablation improvement alone cannot be a paper win.

blocking_issues: Paper-era split bytes and exact source archive/metadata identity are not validated; the current split download cannot silently substitute for them.
Session-local neuron IDs do not establish repeated-cell linkage; label-map and fluorescence-column joins require audit.
No authentic NuCLR rerun or required matching source-comparator rerun for the selected panel is established; EI-inductive selection additionally requires the stronger LOLCAT comparator.
If the inductive panel is selected, its one-mouse test cannot support a general population uncertainty claim by neuron-level resampling.
Selected original endpoint, required controls/companion metrics, meaningful effect, uncertainty, stochastic-rerun calibration tolerance, protected scorer and concrete episode budgets are not fixed.

legacy.notes: The existing supplied-embedding evaluator checks identities, readout behavior and context-ablation diagnostics. Its generated controls and reproduction outputs are calibration only; original graders and historical task materials remain preserved.
